Postgraduate / graduate student enrolled in full-time equivalent

waivers: Medical hardship waiver (season-ending injury in first half of season, under 30% of scheduled contests)

14.5.5.2.10.title: One-Time Transfer Exception (NCAA Division I)
conditions: Student is transferring to Division I for the first time
Student was in good academic standing and meeting PTD at previous institution
Previous institution did not object in writing (notification of transfer entered into NCAA Portal)
Student has not previously transferred from another four-year institution
